SELECT USERID , CATEGORYID , USAGENM , CATEGORYNM , CATEGORYDETAILNM , CLASSIFICATION FROM ACC_CATEGORY WHERE USERID = #{USERID}
AND USAGENM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
AND CATEGORYNM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
AND CATEGORYDETAILNM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
ORDER BY REGDATE DESC

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY BANKNM, ACCOUNTNUM) AS ROWNUM , USERID , ACCOUNTID , BANKNM , ACCOUNTNUM , INITMONEY FROM ACC_ACCOUNT WHERE USERID = #{USERID}
AND BANKNM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
AND ACCOUNTNUM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
ORDER BY BANKNM, ACCOUNTNUM

SELECT s.SAVINGSID , s.USERID , s.SAVINGNM , DATE_FORMAT(s.JOINDATE, '%Y.%m.%d') AS JOINDATE , s.PAYMENTAMOUNT , s.INTERESTRATE , DATE_FORMAT(s.EXPIRATIONDATE, '%Y.%m.%d') AS EXPIRATIONDATE , s.STATUS , s.BANKNAME , s.MEMO , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ACC_SAVINGS_HISTORY h WHERE h.SAVINGSID = s.SAVINGSID AND h.TYPE = 'R' ) AS TOTAL_MONTHS /* 납입기간 총 달 수*/ , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ACC_SAVINGS_HISTORY h WHERE h.SAVINGSID = s.SAVINGSID AND h.TYPE = 'R' AND h.IS_PAID = 'Y' ) AS PAID_MONTHS /* 납입완료 달 수 */ , ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(h.PAYAMOUNT), 0) FROM ACC_SAVINGS_HISTORY h WHERE h.SAVINGSID = s.SAVINGSID AND h.IS_PAID = 'Y' ) AS TOTAL_PAID_AMOUNT , s.REGID , s.REGDATE FROM ACC_SAVINGS s WHERE s.USERID = #{USERID} ORDER BY s.REGDATE DESC

SELECT s.SAVINGSID , s.USERID , s.SAVINGNM , DATE_FORMAT(s.JOINDATE, '%Y.%m.%d') AS JOINDATE , s.PAYMENTAMOUNT , s.INTERESTRATE , DATE_FORMAT(s.EXPIRATIONDATE, '%Y.%m.%d') AS EXPIRATIONDATE , s.STATUS , s.BANKNAME , s.MEMO , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ACC_SAVINGS_HISTORY h WHERE h.SAVINGSID = s.SAVINGSID AND h.TYPE = 'R' ) AS TOTAL_MONTHS /* 납입기간 총 달 수*/ , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ACC_SAVINGS_HISTORY h WHERE h.SAVINGSID = s.SAVINGSID AND h.TYPE = 'R' AND h.IS_PAID = 'Y' ) AS PAID_MONTHS /* 납입완료 달 수 */ , ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(h.PAYAMOUNT), 0) FROM ACC_SAVINGS_HISTORY h WHERE h.SAVINGSID = s.SAVINGSID AND h.IS_PAID = 'Y' ) AS TOTAL_PAID_AMOUNT , s.REGID , s.REGDATE FROM ACC_SAVINGS s WHERE s.USERID = #{USERID} AND s.SAVINGSID= #{SAVINGSID}
